IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'STG_EDS_CRM_PHONEEMAIL' and table_schema = 'd360')
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE d360.STG_EDS_CRM_PHONEEMAIL;
END;

CREATE TABLE [d360].[STG_EDS_CRM_PHONEEMAIL]
( 
	[H]	[varchar](max)	NULL,
	[PHONEEMAILID]	[numeric](38,0)	NULL,
	[BANK_ID]	[varchar](8)	NULL,
	[DONOTDISTURB]	[varchar](1)	NULL,
	[DATEOFREQUEST]	[datetime2](7)	NULL,
	[DNDINITIATEDBY]	[varchar](50)	NULL,
	[HOLDEMAILFLAG]	[varchar](1)	NULL,
	[PHONEEMAILTYPE]	[varchar](200)	NULL,
	[HOLDEMAILINITIATEDBY]	[varchar](50)	NULL,
	[PHONEOREMAIL]	[varchar](50)	NULL,
	[CORP_REP_ID]	[numeric](38,0)	NULL,
	[HOLDEMAILREASON]	[varchar](100)	NULL,
	[CORP_ID]	[numeric](38,0)	NULL,
	[ORGID]	[numeric](38,0)	NULL,
	[ACCOUNTID]	[numeric](38,0)	NULL,
	[CONTACTID]	[numeric](38,0)	NULL,
	[SUSPECTID]	[numeric](38,0)	NULL,
	[PARTNERID]	[numeric](38,0)	NULL,
	[PHONENO]	[varchar](25)	NULL,
	[PHONENOLOCALCODE]	[varchar](20)	NULL,
	[PHONENOCITYCODE]	[varchar](20)	NULL,
	[PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE]	[varchar](20)	NULL,
	[WORKEXTENSION]	[varchar](30)	NULL,
	[EMAIL]	[varchar](50)	NULL,
	[EMAILPALM]	[varchar](150)	NULL,
	[URL]	[varchar](150)	NULL,
	[PREFERREDFLAG]	[varchar](50)	NULL,
	[START_DATE]	[datetime2](7)	NULL,
	[END_DATE]	[datetime2](7)	NULL,
	[NONCUSTOMERID]	[numeric](38,0)	NULL,
	[USERFIELD1]	[varchar](200)	NULL,
	[USERFIELD2]	[varchar](200)	NULL,
	[USERFIELD3]	[varchar](200)	NULL,
	[DATE1]	[datetime2](7)	NULL,
	[DATE2]	[datetime2](7)	NULL,
	[DATE3]	[datetime2](7)	NULL,
	[EXTENSIONID]	[numeric](38,0)	NULL,
	[ORGKEY]	[varchar](50)	NULL,
	[LAST_UPDATED_DATE]	[datetime2](7)	NULL,
	[TMDATE]	[datetime2](7)	NULL,
	[FILE_NAME]	[varchar](100)	NULL,
	[insert_dttm]	[datetime]	NULL

)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = HASH(PHONEEMAILID),
	HEAP
)

IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'STG_EDS_CRM_PHONEEMAIL_SELECT_SRC' and table_schema = 'd360')
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE d360.STG_EDS_CRM_PHONEEMAIL_SELECT_SRC;
END;

CREATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_CRM_PHONEEMAIL_SELECT_SRC
WITH (HEAP, DISTRIBUTION = HASH(PHONEEMAILID))
AS
SELECT 			 TOP 1
				 [PHONEEMAILID]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DONOTDISTURB]
				,[DATEOFREQUEST]
				,[DNDINITIATEDBY]
				,[HOLDEMAILFLAG]
				,[PHONEEMAILTYPE]
				,[HOLDEMAILINITIATEDBY]
				,[PHONEOREMAIL]
				,[CORP_REP_ID]
				,[HOLDEMAILREASON]
				,[CORP_ID]
				,[ORGID]
				,[ACCOUNTID]
				,[CONTACTID]
				,[SUSPECTID]
				,[PARTNERID]
				,[PHONENO]
				,[PHONENOLOCALCODE]
				,[PHONENOCITYCODE]
				,[PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE]
				,[WORKEXTENSION]
				,[EMAIL]
				,[EMAILPALM]
				,[URL]
				,[PREFERREDFLAG]
				,[START_DATE]
				,[END_DATE]
				,[NONCUSTOMERID]
				,[USERFIELD1]
				,[USERFIELD2]
				,[USERFIELD3]
				,[DATE1]
				,[DATE2]
				,[DATE3]
				,[EXTENSIONID]
				,[ORGKEY]
				,[LAST_UPDATED_DATE]
				,[TMDATE]
				,[FILE_NAME] 
				,1 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CRM_PHONEEMAIL]
            WHERE H = 'D' AND 1=2;
			

IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'STG_EDS_CRM_PHONEEMAIL_GROUP_SRC' and table_schema = 'd360')
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE d360.STG_EDS_CRM_PHONEEMAIL_GROUP_SRC;
END;

CREATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_CRM_PHONEEMAIL_GROUP_SRC
WITH (HEAP, DISTRIBUTION = HASH(PHONEEMAILID))
AS
select           TOP 1
				 [PHONEEMAILID]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DONOTDISTURB]
				,[DATEOFREQUEST]
				,[DNDINITIATEDBY]
				,[HOLDEMAILFLAG]
				,[PHONEEMAILTYPE]
				,[HOLDEMAILINITIATEDBY]
				,[PHONEOREMAIL]
				,[CORP_REP_ID]
				,[HOLDEMAILREASON]
				,[CORP_ID]
				,[ORGID]
				,[ACCOUNTID]
				,[CONTACTID]
				,[SUSPECTID]
				,[PARTNERID]
				,[PHONENO]
				,[PHONENOLOCALCODE]
				,[PHONENOCITYCODE]
				,[PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE]
				,[WORKEXTENSION]
				,[EMAIL]
				,[EMAILPALM]
				,[URL]
				,[PREFERREDFLAG]
				,[START_DATE]
				,[END_DATE]
				,[NONCUSTOMERID]
				,[USERFIELD1]
				,[USERFIELD2]
				,[USERFIELD3]
				,[DATE1]
				,[DATE2]
				,[DATE3]
				,[EXTENSIONID]
				,[ORGKEY]
				,[LAST_UPDATED_DATE]
				,[TMDATE]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
				 [PHONEEMAILID]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DONOTDISTURB]
				,[DATEOFREQUEST]
				,[DNDINITIATEDBY]
				,[HOLDEMAILFLAG]
				,[PHONEEMAILTYPE]
				,[HOLDEMAILINITIATEDBY]
				,[PHONEOREMAIL]
				,[CORP_REP_ID]
				,[HOLDEMAILREASON]
				,[CORP_ID]
				,[ORGID]
				,[ACCOUNTID]
				,[CONTACTID]
				,[SUSPECTID]
				,[PARTNERID]
				,[PHONENO]
				,[PHONENOLOCALCODE]
				,[PHONENOCITYCODE]
				,[PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE]
				,[WORKEXTENSION]
				,[EMAIL]
				,[EMAILPALM]
				,[URL]
				,[PREFERREDFLAG]
				,[START_DATE]
				,[END_DATE]
				,[NONCUSTOMERID]
				,[USERFIELD1]
				,[USERFIELD2]
				,[USERFIELD3]
				,[DATE1]
				,[DATE2]
				,[DATE3]
				,[EXTENSIONID]
				,[ORGKEY]
				,[LAST_UPDATED_DATE]
				,[TMDATE]
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME 
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_PHONEEMAIL_SELECT_SRC
	WHERE 1=2
	GROUP BY 					 [PHONEEMAILID]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DONOTDISTURB]
				,[DATEOFREQUEST]
				,[DNDINITIATEDBY]
				,[HOLDEMAILFLAG]
				,[PHONEEMAILTYPE]
				,[HOLDEMAILINITIATEDBY]
				,[PHONEOREMAIL]
				,[CORP_REP_ID]
				,[HOLDEMAILREASON]
				,[CORP_ID]
				,[ORGID]
				,[ACCOUNTID]
				,[CONTACTID]
				,[SUSPECTID]
				,[PARTNERID]
				,[PHONENO]
				,[PHONENOLOCALCODE]
				,[PHONENOCITYCODE]
				,[PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE]
				,[WORKEXTENSION]
				,[EMAIL]
				,[EMAILPALM]
				,[URL]
				,[PREFERREDFLAG]
				,[START_DATE]
				,[END_DATE]
				,[NONCUSTOMERID]
				,[USERFIELD1]
				,[USERFIELD2]
				,[USERFIELD3]
				,[DATE1]
				,[DATE2]
				,[DATE3]
				,[EXTENSIONID]
				,[ORGKEY]
				,[LAST_UPDATED_DATE]
				,[TMDATE]
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 1 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP



IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'CRM_PHONEEMAIL' and table_schema = 'EDS')
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE EDS.CRM_PHONEEMAIL;
END;

	[PHONENO] [varchar](25)  NULL,
	[PHONENOLOCALCODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,

	[WORKEXTENSION] [varchar](30)  NULL,

	[TMDATE] [datetime2](7)  NULL,
	[SCD_Start_Date] [date]  NULL,

	[isActive] [int]  NULL,
	[isLatest] [int]  NULL,
	[BNK_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[SOURCE_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime]  NULL
)
WITH

	DISTRIBUTION = HASH(PHONEEMAILID), HEAP
)
GO
